タイトル: Strong Platform for Scaling Property Management
投稿者: Duy アメリカのOwner 認証済みLinkedInユーザー ホスピタリティ, 2～10人規模の会社 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Strong Platform for Scaling Property Management"
良い点: We’ve had a very positive experience using Hostaway to manage our growing short-term rental portfolio. As a property management company overseeing multiple listings, we needed a system that could handle channel distribution, automation, reporting, and operational scalability — and Hostaway delivers on those fronts. The channel manager is reliable and integrates well with Airbnb, Vrbo, and direct booking channels. Calendar syncing has been consistent, which is critical when managing multiple properties. Automation tools (guest messaging, review requests, task scheduling) have helped us streamline operations and reduce manual workload. We especially appreciate the flexibility of the reporting features. Owner statements, revenue tracking, and payout visibility make it easier to maintain transparency with property owners. The system also integrates well with third-party tools, which allows us to build a more customized tech stack as our business grows. Customer support has been responsive and helpful when we’ve needed assistance, and the platform continues to evolve with new features that support professional property managers — not just individual hosts. Overall, Hostaway has been a strong operational backbone for scaling our short-term rental business. We would recommend it to property managers looking for a robust, growth-oriented PMS solution.
改善点: One area that could be improved is the reporting and accounting depth. While the core reports work well, customizing owner statements and financial breakdowns can require extra manual work or third-party tools. Some features also have a learning curve, especially when setting up automations and integrations. Improvements in UI simplicity and more built-in accounting flexibility would make the platform even stronger.

良い点: Hostaway has made managing multiple properties and bookings much easier by bringing everything together in one place. The platform offers a wide range of features and integrations that help us automate many of our daily tasks and keep our operations organised. I would also particularly like to mention Fatih from the onboarding team. He was fantastic throughout the entire onboarding process. The training sessions were very clear and easy to follow, and he has a great ability to explain even the more complex features in a simple and practical way. He was always friendly, patient, attentive and happy to answer all our questions. Having this level of support made the transition to Hostaway much smoother for us.
改善点: As we are still relatively new to Hostaway, we haven't had enough time to explore the platform in depth and identify any major downsides. So far, the main areas we feel could be improved are related to workflow and ease of use. For example, some changes need to be made directly on the specific booking platform rather than through Hostaway, which can make certain tasks less convenient. Another small frustration is that when we receive a notification for a new guest message and click on it, it takes us to the Hostaway homepage rather than directly to the relevant conversation in the inbox. It would be much more practical if notifications linked straight to the message. These are relatively minor points, though, and overall our experience so far has been very positive.

The team is responsive, knowledgeable, and genuinely committed to helping users succeed. Anytime we’ve needed assistance, the support staff has been patient, informative, and quick to resolve issues. Hostaway has helped streamline our business, improve efficiency, and make property management far less stressful. We highly recommend it to anyone managing short-term rentals and looking for a reliable, professional property management platform.
改善点: At this time, we honestly do not have any negatives to report about Hostaway. Our experience has been very positive overall. The platform has been reliable, easy to use, and extremely helpful for managing our property listings across multiple booking channels. The integrations work smoothly, the automation tools save us a lot of time, and the customer support team has been excellent whenever we’ve needed assistance. So far, Hostaway has met or exceeded our expectations, and we look forward to continuing to grow our business using their platform.

タイトル: Once you use Hostaway as a channel manager there is no way you could go back to life without it.
投稿者: Joanne 英国のCEO ホスピタリティ, 自営業 使用期間： 1～5か月 共有 "Once you use Hostaway as a channel manager there is no way you could go back to life without it."
良い点: Pleasant user-friendly graphics and design of calendar, great way of looking at the financials - eg the analytic tools give you 'at a glance' on revenue, or per OTA, or % occupancy, the link to a payment API (I use Stripe), a means to add 'extras' to invoices eg luxury welcome pack, or bottle of wine.Messaging - you can do it all from the Hostaway platform (although as yet no means to add emojis if you like doing that - they are looking at it though). I believe they are integrating WhatsApp. I've only just completed my initial training (7 hours) so I only have a basic overview so far.I had a very patient trainer who ran through things with me. Just don't expect to be at expert level for a while. It takes the trainers 4 weeks to learn the system and learn how to train us, plus other internal stuff just for them. But probably up to 3 weeks of that time is learning how to operate the platform right? So 15 days at 7 hours a day? I have done 7 hours and I'm 'launched' but far from competent if I'm honest. There is amply help available though using the 'help' button on the platform. I haven't tried it yet.Be realistic, especially if you are not particularly 'techy'. One piece of advice - learn how to share your screen on Google Meetings, providing all the necessary permissions on your device, before your first training session. I wasted 20 mins of my first training session trying to get to share my screen (or 'Present') as it's called on Google Meetings.
改善点: I would like the main calendar (not the mobile one) to highlight the day that is 'today' in some way. A different colour, or a coloured line around the day. This would make it really easy to find when you are scrolling backwards and forwards.A small thing, but I look forward to being able to include emojis in my messaging.Overall, I think it would be useful to have more training sessions scheduled at the beginning of the onboarding. Of course you can ask anything you like, but you don't always know what you need to ask! Perhaps after a couple of weeks you have a scheduled training session so that you can go through the things you are having difficulty with. Of course, you do have the 'Help' button. But by now you are familiar with your trainer who helped at the start, and it would be good to have a principal person to assist rather than going into the pot with any 'Help' operative.
